name: Transformer gas-accumulation alarm input
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Receives the defined gas-accumulation alarm from an applicable liquid-filled transformer gas relay.
description: Receives the defined gas-accumulation alarm from an applicable liquid-filled transformer gas relay. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Gas-relay alarm contact” at the input and “Transformer gas alarm” at the output. The contact does not establish the cause of gas accumulation.
